# `edit.poke`: Poke

Splits each face into a fan of triangles around a new center vertex, optionally raised into a pyramid.

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(c log c) for the c corners of the selected faces, plus the selector
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: poke faces, pyramid, spike, fan triangulate, poke

Every selected face is replaced by one triangle per edge, meeting at a new vertex at the face center; `offset` moves that vertex along the normal (spikes, studs, low-poly gems, pyramid roofs). Triangles keep the face's groups and are also `<label>.faces`.

**Not for** general triangulation (use `edit.triangulate`: it adds no vertices).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offset` | `Length` | `0.0` | Moves each new center vertex along its face normal (a pyramid when positive). |
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Faces to poke; every face when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"offset":"5cm","select":{"faces":{"group":"top"}},"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): poked 1 face into 4 triangles; group poke_1.faces`
